comment: Reference voices for the Chatterbox pre-render (BRIEF_PHASE8 N-00). Only donated TTS voices (owner choice 2026-10-04); no LibriVox/MLS readers, no real person cloned without having released their voice for synthesis. Pools: two female and two male voices per language, native-language donors first; every voice scored >= 82% in the Whisper round trip (voices/chatterbox_voice_test.txt). fa is not supported by the model (stays on Piper); id stays on its current voices.
